Manuscript annotations and underlining in the margins and above the head are handwriting and are left out. A signature mark sits at the foot right.

main_text.p: baret nuda & simplex narratio: sed quū additur, sicuti Deus praeceperat, nihilo magis obloqui fas est, quā vbi de sceleratis poena exigitur. Etsi autē nostro iudicio pueri saltem ac multae quoque mulieres essent extra culpā, meminerimus nostris legibus caeleste tribunal minimè subiici. Quin potius vbi sic videmus ardere viridespla-tas, nos qui lignū aridum sumus, nobis metuamus à graviore interitu. Et certe si se quisque probè excutiat, cetum mortibus dignū reperiet. Cur non itaque Deus materiam vnius mortis iustam agnoscet in fœtu vix dum matris vterum egressō? Frustra quidem obstreperis querelis exagitabimus, quòd sobolem quoque getis maledictæ in eundem coniecit interitum: quia singulo nihilominus in sua vasa vel potius in lutū, summa erit potestas. Vltimus versus confirmat quod ante dixi, fuisse toti populo stationem in Gilgal: ac milites qui ad bellum exierant illuc reuersos, tum vt se à lassitudine reficerent, tum vt prædas deponerent in tuto. Neque enim cōsentaneum fuisset longius spargi, donec sortitio monstraret vbi singulis manendum esset.
main_text.head: CAPVT XI.
main_text.p: 1CVM [?] autem audisset Iabim rex Hasor, misit ad Iobab regem Madam, & ad regem Simerō, & ad regem Achsaph.

page.notes: The decorated initial letter is hard to read; the first word is read as CVM with [?]. The printed text reads "Frustra quidem obstreperis querelis exagitabimus" as set. The signature mark "M.iiL" is doubtful. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Handwritten annotations and underlining are excluded.
